description: From verifier PASS on 410b87b. R1a: a later buffered chunk can activate before an older stale chunk's re-observed remainder (group order). R1b: a non-null context_edit that restores an omitted entry revives the stale chunk next to its replacement (double coverage). R1c: /om shows state.buffered.length including stale chunks; show live count. R2 rest: two compactions with no progress produce identical summaries; prefer returning undefined when keep did not move since the last compaction. Probes: scratchpad review/v2-dup.mts, v2-r2.mts.

comments.text: More follow-ups from review round 3 (all low): #4 OM-set session title counts as user-named after /tree (getSessionName reads whole file, omTitles from branch only); #7 retry history lost on degenerate-output retries; #8 gap markers and the continuation reminder create consecutive user messages (Bedrock Converse strict alternation unverified); #9 reflection provenance collapses to one kind=reflection group (same as Mastra), recall on it returns the oldest ~20k only; package-version test in pi-hashline-readmap reads gitignored package-lock.json, so it fails in worktrees.

title: pi-om v2 follow-ups: activation order after stale chunk, revived stale chunk, /om stale count, no-progress compaction
